Package index

Surveys

Discovering studies and their documentation. Metadata only: no supported source permits programmatic download of microdata.

knbs_search_surveys() experimental
Search official survey and census studies
knbs_survey_metadata() experimental
Retrieve the full metadata record for a study
knbs_variables() experimental
Search the variables described by a study
knbs_survey_files() experimental
List the data files belonging to a study
knbs_download_microdata() experimental
Download public-use microdata

Publications

Statistical releases, reports and workbooks from the KNBS website, with verified, checksummed downloads.

knbs_publications() experimental
Search official KNBS publications
knbs_download_publication() experimental
Download a publication and verify what arrived

Statistical Abstract tables

Curated, validated extraction of the Statistical Abstract’s chapter workbooks into tidy tables.

knbs_abstract_tables() experimental
List the curated Statistical Abstract tables
knbs_abstract_table() experimental
Retrieve one Statistical Abstract table as tidy observations

Indicators and prices

Census tables (CC BY 4.0), the monthly consumer price series, and the retail prices of the CPI basket commodities.

knbs_indicators() experimental
List available aggregate indicators
knbs_get_indicator() experimental
Retrieve an indicator as tidy observations
knbs_retail_prices() experimental
National average retail prices of the CPI basket commodities

Geography

The coded territorial hierarchy of the 2019 census frame — the join keys the census tables themselves use.

knbs_geographies() experimental
Kenya's geographic reference codes

Sources

What the package knows about each KNBS source, and how far that source has been verified.

knbs_sources()
Supported KNBS sources
knbs_status()
Report on the health of supported sources

Provenance

Every object the package returns carries where it came from, when it was retrieved and how to cite it.

knbs_metadata()
Inspect the provenance of a knbsdata object
knbs_cite()
Cite a knbsdata object

Configuration

Session options controlling caching, timeouts and retries.

knbs_option()
Get a knbsdata option
knbs_options()
Set knbsdata options

Cache

Inspecting and clearing locally cached responses.

knbs_cache_dir()
Where knbsdata stores cached responses
knbs_cache_info()
What is in the cache
knbs_cache_clear()
Empty the cache
knbs_cache_prune()
Remove expired cache entries
